Repair User Guide — Factory

Type 1: Under Warranty - RUG — Tested OK

Source: Odoo Tour Recorder export — Tour/2C. Repair User Guide - Factory [ Under Warranty - RUG - Tested Ok ].json

Scenario: The product is under warranty and has a serial number and a warranty card. It is checked at the factory and found Tested OK, returned to the sales centre and dispatched back to the customer.
Every screenshot below is a real capture from a single, clean, passing automated run — taken before each step's action, with the element to use framed in red.

1. Overview

This manual explains how to register and complete a factory repair for a product that is under warranty (RUG) when the technician finds the item Tested OK — nothing needs repairing. It runs from the Helpdesk ticket, through the factory and the sales centre, to dispatch back to the customer.

Ticket stages covered

New Sent to Factory Received at Factory Repair Completed Sent to Sales Centre Received at Sales Centre Handed Over to Customer

Before you start

  • You have access to the Helpdesk, Field Service and Inventory apps.
  • The active company (top bar) is Jinasena Agricultural Machinery (Pvt) Ltd.
  • The customer and the finished product (with its serial number, already sold through a sales order) already exist in Odoo.
  • The customer has brought the item and a photo of the warranty card is available.

Step summary

SectionStepsPurpose
A1–12Open Helpdesk, create the ticket, classify it as Under Warranty - RUG, enter the serial number and attach the warranty card.

Section A — Create the Repair Ticket (Steps 1–12)

1 Open the HelpDesk app
NavigationOdoo Home → Apps
ActionClick the Helpdesk app icon on the home screen.
DescriptionOpens the Helpdesk Overview dashboard, showing every support team you have access to.
Odoo Apps home screen — Helpdesk app icon
2 Open the repair tickets
NavigationHelpdesk → Overview → Customer Care - Repair
ActionOn the Customer Care - Repair team card, click Tickets.
DescriptionDisplays the created tickets and their information.
Helpdesk Overview — Tickets button on the Customer Care - Repair team card
3 Create a new ticket
NavigationHelpdesk → Customer Care - Repair (Tickets)
ActionClick New at the top-left of the ticket list.
DescriptionOpens a blank Helpdesk ticket form for the repair item received from the customer.
All Tickets list — New button
4 Assign the ticket to yourself
NavigationNew ticket form
ActionClick Assign to Me in the status bar.
DescriptionSaves the ticket for the first time and assigns it to the current user. This also generates the ticket's sequence-based name (e.g. REPAIR/2026/01643) — the ticket has no user-editable title.
Blank new ticket form — Assign to Me button
5 Set the repair Type
NavigationTicket form → Type field
ActionClick the Type field and select Repair - Under Warranty - RUG.
DescriptionSelects the Under Warranty - RUG flow: the product is still under warranty and the repair is carried out at the company's cost under the RUG facility. For this type a Serial Number and a photo of the Warranty Card are required (there is no Create Serial No button).
Ticket form — Type field
6 Set the Return Receipt Location
NavigationTicket form → Return Receipt Location field
ActionClick Return Receipt Location and select the branch receiving the item (e.g. BR-AM/Stock, Jinasena Ampara Branch).
DescriptionThe location where the item is received for repair.
Ticket form — Return Receipt Location field
7 Select the Repair Reason
NavigationTicket form → Repair Reason field
ActionClick Repair Reason and select the reported fault (e.g. Difficult to start the engine).
DescriptionA list of common errors is provided; select the ones that apply. This is a tags field.
Ticket form — Repair Reason field
8 Select the Job Location
NavigationTicket form → Job Location field
ActionIn Job Location, select Factory Repair.
DescriptionDefines where the repair will be performed. Factory Repair means the item is sent to the factory, which adds the Send to Factory / Received at Factory steps.
Ticket form — Job Location field
9 Select the Customer
NavigationTicket form → Customer field
ActionClick Customer and select KURUNEGALA CASH CUSTOMER.
DescriptionEmail and Phone are filled automatically from the customer record.
Ticket form — Customer field
10 Enter the Serial Number
NavigationTicket form → Serial Number field
ActionClick Serial Number, type the serial number of the finished product (e.g. 0630_008) and select it from the list.
DescriptionType the serial number of the finished product that was sold through a sales order; only serials already sold to a customer are offered. Selecting it fills in the Product automatically (here [JMC6] Multi Chopper 6Hp (Tractor Type)), so there is no separate Product step.
Ticket form — Serial Number field
Ticket form — Serial Number entered, Product filled in

NavigationTicket form → Warranty Details tab
ActionClick the Warranty Details tab.
DescriptionYou must attach one or two images of the warranty card; this tab holds the Warranty Card image.
Ticket form — Warranty Details tab

NavigationTicket form → Warranty Details → Warranty Card

QA notes
  • Steps 1-19 follow the "Approved Full Flow" (2A) guide: Serial Number and Warranty Card instead of Create Serial No. From the task onward this flow follows the Tested OK guide (1B): Tested OK replaces diagnosis / image / parts / quotation / RUG approval / deliveries.
  • The Serial Number field only offers serials already sold to a customer. The tour typed its own serial; the automated run picks a sold serial of the product with zero on-hand quantity and a clean history (this run used 0630_008). The Product field is filled from the serial, so there is no separate Product step.
  • The Return button (fix_repair_action_direct_return) raises "You may only return Done pickings" server-side but still creates the Returned Picking first. The automated run swallows the error, then validates the receipt via /web/dataset/call_kw (the picking's Validate button is hidden/unreliable under the Studio views). The receipt opens as a full page, so the Back screenshot (step 15) shows the Done receipt without a framed button.
  • Send to Sales Centre and Dispatch become visible only after a full page reload once the previous action completes. A hash-only navigation does not refresh the record, so the automated flow uses page.reload() in a polling loop.
  • Each screenshot is captured immediately before the step's action with the target element framed in red (a temporary CSS outline applied to the live element only for the capture); result screenshots (serial entered, warranty card attached, final ticket) have no box. Screenshots come from one clean, passing automated run against the staging instance.
  • The "Add Data" toast notifications on the Tested OK screenshot (diagnosis/image not set) are expected for this shortcut path; they do not block the flow.
  • The staging database is a temporary Odoo.sh environment, automatically deleted on 12 October 2026; regenerate the screenshots on the production instance if needed.
